bio_text: Jawad Koradia is a London-based serial founder and former senior finance executive who founded Macrohedge, a boutique hedge fund, in 2012 after stints at Tudor Investment Corp and Nomura, and later served as Global Head of Local Markets STIRT at Citi. He completed the On Deck Fellowship (ODF22) and is now founder of Collaborative Intelligence, Inc., an AI-focused company incorporated in 2024. He holds an MSc in Finance from LSE and has been active in the UK startup ecosystem as both a founder and angel investor.
